profile.headline: Senior .NET Developer & Software Architect | C#, Python, APIs, AWS & Azure | Full Stack & SaaS | Founder, ONYX Tech | AI Integration | PMP, MBA
profile.summary:
I am a Senior .NET Developer, full stack engineer, and software architect with 25+ years of experience designing, modernizing, and supporting enterprise applications across auto insurance, title insurance, healthcare, financial services, and government consulting.
My foundation is C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, SQL Server, Entity Framework, REST/SOAP services, and Windows applications. At Old Republic Title (2010–2026), I developed enterprise applications, modernized legacy VB6 systems, built a WinForms application used by 300+ employees, and added automated tests to Azure DevOps YAML builds.
Since 2025, I have also been the founder and hands-on software architect of ONYX Tech, building salon technology across websites, POS, booking, operations, advertising automation, and mobile apps. I own architecture, data modeling, implementation, delivery, and production operations.
Selected ONYX work:
• NailSites: a Python-driven website platform with 124 themes, approximately 117 paying salon tenants, and roughly 19,440 pre-built salon listings.
• Salon operations: multi-tenant POS, technician dispatch and rotation, booking workflows, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, and commission ledgers.
• Advertising automation: Node.js/TypeScript, Fastify, Prisma, BullMQ, Redis, Google Ads API, approval controls, idempotent changes, and spending limits.
• Mobile and AI: Swift/SwiftUI apps, Supabase/PostgREST, Cloudflare R2 media pipelines, AI image classification, and Lacquer MCP tools for conversational salon booking.
I design for reliability through explicit state machines, idempotency, optimistic concurrency, tenant isolation, audit trails, and transaction-safe asynchronous processing. My broader experience includes AWS, Azure, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, React, Next.js, Python automation, Agile/Scrum, mentoring, and production troubleshooting.
I use Claude Code and Codex alongside engineering judgment, testing, and review to deliver maintainable software.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and MBA, The University of Akron. Certifications include Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, PMP, and Certified ScrumMaster.
U.S. citizen based in Santa Monica, California. Interested in fully remote senior engineering and architecture opportunities.
Contact: luubao@gmail.com

positions.title: Founder, Software Architect, and Engineer
positions.description:
Founder and hands-on architect of salon SaaS products spanning websites, POS, booking, operations, advertising automation, native iOS apps, and conversational AI integrations. Own architecture, data modeling, implementation, delivery, and production operations.
• Architect and operate NailSites: approximately 117 paying salon tenants, 19,440 pre-built listings, and a rollout toward 88,000 sites. Maintain a Python website generator with 124 themes, shared JSON data, HTML/CSS templates, Google Places provisioning, and cached OpenAI content generation.
• Develop multi-tenant salon POS and operations software with technician rotation, dispatch, booking, Stripe Terminal payments, commission ledgers, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, and Vietnamese-first localization.
• Build Node.js/TypeScript advertising automation using Fastify, Prisma, BullMQ, Redis, and Google Ads API, with human approval gates, idempotent changes, and atomic spending limits.
• Publish iOS apps under ONYX Tech LLC. Architect SwiftUI discovery experiences with Supabase/PostgREST, Cloudflare R2 media storage, image-intake state machines, perceptual-hash deduplication, and Claude batch classification of roughly 100,000 images.
• Develop Lacquer MCP tools for salon discovery, availability, appointment booking, and cancellation through conversational AI.
• Apply guarded state machines, optimistic locking, database idempotency constraints, audit logs, tenant isolation, and post-commit asynchronous processing.
• Use Git/GitHub, Claude Code, and Codex; lead a remote outreach team and translate operational feedback into product requirements.
Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Swift/SwiftUI, Next.js, React, React Native/Expo, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare R2, Prisma, BullMQ, Redis, Stripe Terminal, OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and supported enterprise software for title insurance and financial services, spanning desktop applications, web portals, APIs, workflow automation, and reporting.
• Designed and developed an automation portal from the ground up as part of a seven-person team.
• Built a WinForms application used by 300+ employees, implementing the UI, business layer, and ADO.NET database connectivity.
• Modernized legacy VB6 applications using C#, .NET Framework, WinForms, WCF, WPF, and .NET Core MVC.
• Developed RESTful APIs, Web API and SOAP integrations; worked across C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, SSRS, React, AngularJS, and Node.js.
• Refactored AngularJS services and directives for reuse across applications, reducing duplicated code and redundant HTTP requests.
• Added automated unit tests to Azure DevOps build triggers using YAML; worked with TFS, Octopus Deploy, and Checkmarx.
• Gathered requirements, modeled business workflows, maintained requirements documentation, and designed database schemas.
• Collaborated with analysts and Agile teams to build, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise solutions.
Technologies: C#, .NET, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, SQL Server, SSRS, ADO.NET, REST, SOAP, WCF, WPF, WinForms, React, AngularJS, Azure DevOps, YAML, TFS, Octopus Deploy, Checkmarx.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
• Upgraded and maintained C#/.NET SaaS web applications using N-tier architecture and SQL Server.
• Designed service-oriented components for reusable code, loose coupling, scalability, and isolated testing.
• Led team-wide work to analyze and improve test coverage of core business processing components.
• Provided technical guidance and mentored less experienced developers.
• Collaborated in two-week Agile/Scrum sprints, delivering tested code using NUnit and test-driven development.
• Worked independently on both well-defined tasks and problems requiring further analysis.
Technologies: C#, .NET, SQL Server, service-oriented architecture, NUnit, Agile/Scrum, test-driven development.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, created and administered application with .NET C#, ASP.NET AJAX, html, and CSS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
• Performed software analysis, design, development, and configuration, including definition of technical requirements.
• Investigated and resolved complex application defects and incidents, escalating issues when appropriate.
• Created reusable interface components and improved website navigation and usability.
• Developed and administered web applications using C#, ASP.NET AJAX, HTML, and CSS.
• Contributed to SharePoint-based internal sites using SharePoint, InfoPath, SQL Server, and Visual Studio.
• Worked as an individual contributor toward shared team delivery goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a C# data server adapter to deliver data to client applications.
• Built JavaScript, C#, and VB.NET clients to receive and work with adapter data.
• Applied binary trees, quicksort, hashing, and queues to improve data processing efficiency.
• Developed and maintained .NET web applications, SQL Server data access, stored procedures, Windows services, and IIS-hosted functionality.
Technologies: C#, JavaScript, VB.NET, ASP.NET AJAX, ADO.NET, SQL Server, Windows services, IIS, HTML, CSS, XML, XSLT.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered software through the full development lifecycle, from requirements and implementation to testing, production release, and maintenance.
• Collaborated with business analysts, managers, and quality assurance staff to define and deliver application functionality.
• Developed and supported production .NET websites, Windows services, and desktop applications.
• Created actuarial Windows applications and reporting workflows using VB.NET, IBM DB2, SSRS, and VBA.
• Performed integration testing, defect correction, and ongoing application modernization.
Technologies: .NET, VB.NET, IBM DB2, SSRS, VBA, Windows services, desktop applications, web development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Modernized legacy Visual Basic 6 applications on the Microsoft .NET platform.
• Developed WinForms applications, designed user interfaces, connected to IBM DB2, and generated Excel reports.
• Led a multi-thousand-hour initiative to automate a manual business process.
• Developed complex queries, stored procedures, and functions to retrieve and process application data.
• Used Microsoft Foundation Class Library components to call Windows APIs and work with Windows objects.
• Partnered with business analysts and users to gather requirements and translate them into software functionality.
Technologies: VB6, .NET, WinForms, IBM DB2, SQL, Excel, MFC, Windows APIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Began professional software engineering career developing and maintaining business applications supporting insurance operations.
• Built and supported Windows and web application features and SQL-based data access as part of an enterprise development team.
• Investigated and resolved production defects and collaborated with business users and analysts to implement application changes.
